title: Arrive in a plastic bag and damaged
text:
Arrive in a plastic bag and damaged. Ball products are wonderful for canning. However Amazon’s packaging or lack thereof allowed damage to a good product as well as the manufacturers original box. It’s sometimes a waste of time for the buyer and the actual product from the manufacturer when care isn’t taken to protect the items being shipped.

Without proper inspection of these lids and rings, this could have been very dangerous to use in a pressure canner.
Amazon your minimalistic approach to shipping materials is damaging too many items. Please take enough care to see that the items we need arrive undamaged. Thanks for the credit, but this still sucks.
